When set to true, API returns only collection of identifiers instead of collection of payments.
Limits result to payments created since StartDate.
Limits result to payments created before EndDate.
When set to true, API returns only unsettled payments.
You can filter the payments by specifying a set of payment IDs.

response.name: Collection of payments that match criteria.
